a: toSorted can take compare functions for custom order.
Object.groupBy groups items by callback keys.
Map.groupBy returns a Map of grouped items.
Set.prototype.union returns a set of all elements in either set.
Set.prototype.difference returns elements in one set not the other.
symmetricDifference returns elements in either set but not both.
isSubsetOf checks whether all elements are in another set.
isSupersetOf checks whether a set contains another set.
